title: TenantSecurityUserPerm - Data API
description: Stores information on permissions assigned to a user. Use this object to see which tenants a user is assigned to. This object is available to Security Center subscribers in API version 53.0 and later.

Action.description: The action taken regarding the user’s permission. The options are: Added Removed

ActionBy.description: This field is reserved for future use.

ActionDate.description: The date that the permission action was taken.

Context.description: The name of the profile or permission set assigned to the user.

ContextType.description: Indicates the method through which the permission was granted. The options are: Permission Set Profile

DataSpaceName.description: The name of the data space where the tenant security user permission is tracked.

DetailIdentifier.description: The ID of the individual detail record. This field is unique within your org.

MetricIdentifier.description: The ID of the type of metric that was counted.

MetricsType.description: The type of metric that the assigned permission represents.

Name.description: The name of the metric for which data is being collected.

Tenant.description: The ID of the tenant where the user permission was applied.

TenantName.description: The name of the connected tenant where the user permission was applied.

UserLicense.description: The license assigned to the user.

special_access_rules: This object can only be read and queried.
associated_objects:
This object has these associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, it’s available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, it’s available in the specified API version and later.

- **TenantSecurityUserPermChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityUserPermFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityUserPermHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **TenantSecurityUserPermOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityUserPermShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
